baseline.head: 7879aff
baseline.note: stable construction baseline; main and owner-result are never updated by Host-M

constraint: 新增优先，侵入式修改从严；外围增强优先，核心重构禁止

phases.title: System Acceptance Hub
deliverables: src/shared/acceptance-hub.ts — closed PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED_EXTERNAL/DEGRADED/SKIPPED_WITH_REASON vocabulary, worst-first rollup, id=status digest, selection that rejects unknown ids
src/shared/acceptance-record.ts — the small stable record P6 compares baseline→candidate against
electron/host/acceptance-catalog.ts — 25 checks across build/legacy/closure/tenx/engine/host with a declared entry point per check
electron/host/acceptance-hub-runner.ts — per-check fault isolation, build gates ordered first, bounded evidence tails
electron/host/process-runner.ts — shell-free spawning with Windows shim resolution, timeout enforcement and tree kill
scripts/host-acceptance.cjs — one command; exit 0 only on overall PASS

phases.title: Failure Injection Lab
deliverables: src/shared/fault-lab.ts — the thirteen declared fault classes, five verdicts, classifyFault ordered so nothing-proven beats missed beats contained
electron/host/fault-lab.ts — thirteen injectors over the real subsystems, each graded on inject/observe/contain, run inside its own temp directory
scripts/host-fault-lab.cjs — CLI; exit 0 only when every fault is CONTAINED or ACCEPTED_DEGRADATION

phases.title: Long-run / Soak Harness
deliverables: src/shared/soak-harness.ts — smoke/30m/2h/8h/overnight tiers with their own audit bars, eleven invariants with declared bounds, verdict requiring duration AND invariants
electron/host/soak-harness.ts — real load through the real supervisor with continuous resource sampling and a resumable heartbeat
scripts/host-soak.cjs — CLI; exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 3 BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, 4 INCOMPLETE_WITH_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE

phases.title: Unified Observability
deliverables: src/shared/host-observer.ts — pure projection over eight domains with per-dimension OK/DEGRADED/UNAVAILABLE and a READ_ONLY marker
src/shared/host-maturity-flags.ts — Host-M's own fail-closed flag registry, separate from the Engine's adaptive flags
electron/host/host-observer-collector.ts — read-only collector that avoids the two existing reads which persist as a side effect
scripts/host-observe.cjs — CLI

phases.title: Evidence / Artifact Inspector
deliverables: src/shared/evidence-inspector.ts — classification, queries, provenance tracing, three-anchor reference resolution, hashes-first comparison
electron/host/evidence-inspector.ts — bounded read-only walk with sha256, BOM-tolerant JSON, orphan/invalid/dangling detection
scripts/host-evidence.cjs — CLI with --compare for baseline→candidate
phases.findings: 44 BOM files and 1 genuinely malformed file reported (pre-existing, not repaired); 53 real dangling references; 146 orphans

phases.title: Regression Sentinel
deliverables: src/shared/regression-sentinel.ts — nine dimensions, five finding severities, failures only on a regression
electron/host/sentinel-capture.ts — source-text interface capture, BOM-tolerant evidence reads, per-dimension isolation
scripts/host-regression.cjs — CLI; exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 4 DRIFT

phases.title: Diagnostics / Doctor
deliverables: src/shared/doctor.ts — eleven areas, four statuses with no stop verdict, runProbe fault isolation
electron/host/doctor.ts — 25 read-only probes, blocking only on runtime/filesystem/dependency
scripts/host-doctor.cjs — CLI; exit 0 READY, 1 DEGRADED, 3 BLOCKED

gates.acceptance_hub: node scripts/host-acceptance.cjs runs the whole acceptance surface in one command
gates.evidence_inspector: Host-M scope clean; whole-plan findings are pre-existing and reported, not repaired
gates.regression_sentinel: PASS: 0 regressions, 0 drift against the recorded baseline
gates.doctor: READY: 15 READY, 0 DEGRADED, 0 FAIL, 10 SKIPPED (all 'no evidence on this data root yet')

removability: Every Host-M module is an outer shell: delete src/shared/{acceptance-hub,acceptance-record,fault-lab,soak-harness,host-observer,host-maturity-flags,evidence-inspector,regression-sentinel,doctor}.ts, electron/host/** and scripts/host-*.cjs and Boss runs unchanged. No frozen-area protocol, schema or persistence format was modified.
note: Host-M does not claim FINAL SYSTEM ACCEPTED; system-level close-out belongs to the later integration stage.
